reviews.review: What more can I say it's EDF and it's fun! The voice overs of the AI soldiers are funny and the game plays is just mindless fun. This is a game I need in my life when I want to take a break from a day of hard work. The game is also a great challenge with or without friends. The offline story can do split screen for two players (coach coop) and online is a more difficult version of the offline story but up to 4 players. I would recommend you find a few friends online to help you out on some of the harder missions. If you are on the fence wait for a sale and get the game it is fun game and you get 4 classes to play with, with tons of weapons to unlock. I have about 300+ hours in and I'm at 46% of the game complete, meaning you have to beat the game on Inferno difficulty with all four classes to get 100%. Also there are 5 difficulties: easy, normal, hard, hardest and inferno. You get new and upgrade weapon level unlocks for each difficulty maxing out each weapon would help beat some of the harder mission also with increasing your armor, which I've seem people with 50K plus which is allot. The offline is uncapped armor while the online is capped armor and makes the online harder and the same goes for weapons each difficulty is capped a curtain weapon levels and goes up as you progress. From my understanding once you complete the game 100% you can use any weapon level online to help people out and the armor is uncapped as well. Hope this helps.  All the best to everyone! <3
